## Primary estimand

Delta (SIM minus RAND, adaptive) = -0.0355 rad, 95 % percentile bootstrap CI [-0.0535, -0.0200] (10,000 resamples, seed 7), paired t CI [-0.0560, -0.0151], d_z = -1.24, n = 10 seeds. Decision under the frozen rule: **reject H0**.

Pre-specified secondary, drift per accepted item, SIM minus RAND: -0.000419 rad per accepted track, 95 % CI [-0.000605, -0.000263].
